name: Codex Security Cloud
desc: Scan your repositories on a schedule and get proposed fixes.
desc_zh: 定时扫描你的代码仓库，并拿到修好的建议补丁。
solves: A security scan is a one-off report nobody re-runs. Codex Security Cloud re-checks new commits, deduplicates findings, and prepares a fix for review while you are away.
solves_zh: 安全扫描往往是一次性报告，没人会再跑第二遍。Codex Security Cloud 会复查新提交、去掉重复项，并趁你不在时备好修复方案等你审。
best_for: You own a repository and want new commits checked without running the scan yourself.
best_for_zh: 你负责一个仓库，想让新提交自动被检查而不用自己动手。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI DevDay 2026 recap, https://openai.com/index/devday-2026-recap）。 ChatGPT release notes, entry under the "September 29, 2026" heading. Access to Daybreak Blue models inside Codex Security Cloud is included; a separate Daybreak application is not required. 首次公开日期来源：https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
